items.title: GV/LV booth at CityWide Dallas
items.summary: Stop by our Grapevine and La Viña literature table at CityWide Dallas, the monthly AA gathering at Lover's Lane United Methodist Church (potluck at 5:30 PM, speaker at 7:00 PM). Browse the magazines and ask us how to subscribe or how to become a GVR or RLV.

extra.location: Lover's Lane United Methodist Church, 9200 Inwood Road, Dallas, TX 75220

title.en: GV/LV booth at CityWide Dallas
title.es: Mesa de GV/LV en CityWide Dallas

summary.en: Stop by our Grapevine and La Viña literature table at CityWide Dallas, the monthly AA gathering at Lover's Lane United Methodist Church (potluck at 5:30 PM, speaker at 7:00 PM). Browse the magazines and ask us how to subscribe or how to become a GVR or RLV.
summary.es: Visita nuestra mesa de literatura de Grapevine y La Viña en CityWide Dallas, la reunión mensual de AA en la Iglesia Metodista Unida Lover's Lane (comida compartida a las 5:30 p. m. y orador a las 7:00 p. m.). Hojea las revistas y pregúntanos cómo suscribirte o ser RLV o GVR.

recurrence_label.es: 2.º sábado de cada mes · 5:00–8:00 p. m.
